newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Communists await Socialist policy reply-Hue.
newsitem.headline: French Communists await Socialist policy reply-Hue.

text.p: French Communist leader Robert Hue said on Monday his party agreed in principle to join a left-wing government but was awaiting awaiting replies from the Socialist party on policy commitments.

"At this time, we are taking action to get (prime minister-designate) Lionel Jospin and the Socialist party to give undertakings. Everything can still be cleared up within the available timeframe," Hue told a news conference.
Hue said the Communists' policymaking national council had adopted a resolution proposing that the party take part in a left-wing government subject to agreement on policy.
"The Communist Party will continue to intervene with all its constructive, unitary energy to ensure that the change which the majority of our people want becomes a reality," he said.
The resolution was due to be put to grassroots Communist organisations at meetings on Monday night and discussed again at another national council session on Tuesday.

Hue said he had written to Jospin on Monday seeking policy clarifications following a private meeting they held last Friday on the last day of campaigning. The combined left won 319 of the 577 National Assembly seats in Sunday's runoff, with the 38 Communists holding the balance of power in parliament.
